title: V1 engine, run per scenario
label: Illustrative run, seed 0 -- the findings are the 5-seed results in Chapter 2. 12 epochs on one seed (the experiments use 40 epochs over 5 seeds), so this is not evidence under docs/CONTRACT.md section 5.

scenario_descriptions.clean: No corruption. The baseline every other scenario is read against.
scenario_descriptions.clone: k exact duplicates of one view are appended -- redundancy with no new information.
scenario_descriptions.missing: Each (sample, view) is dropped independently at the given rate.
scenario_descriptions.noisy: Gaussian noise on one view. Part 08: this makes a view LESS dependent, not more.
scenario_descriptions.chorus: Part 09 collusive attack: k views optimised jointly to agree on one wrong class.
scenario_descriptions.adaptive: Part 14: the Chorus attacker plus an evasion term that penalises measured dependence.

engine.note: every value is a return value of these functions, reached through app.py, which this build imports and does not edit
